probes.question: What percentage of employed adults had the opportunity to work from home at least one day a week, according to the national survey?
verbatim: indicating that 58% of the employed adults had the opportunity to work from home at least one day a week

probes.question: On what date was the study finding that productivity was largely unaffected by remote work released?
According to Carrie Woods, what has given even small firms the ability to maintain competitive operational efficiencies while supporting a distributed workforce?
probes.answer: Recent advances in AI and machine learning
verbatim: Carrie Woods, CTO of Bright Horizon Technologies, pointed out on December 1, 2023, that recent advances in AI and machine learning have provided even small firms the ability to maintain competitive operational efficiencies while supporting a distributed workforce

probes.question: What did environmental consultant Lisa Park observe about urban air quality?
probes.answer: A modest yet tangible improvement in urban air quality
verbatim: Environmental consultant, Lisa Park, observed a modest yet tangible improvement in urban air quality, as documented in her September 2023 report.

probes.question: On what date did employment lawyer Greg Martinez caution businesses to stay informed about remote work regulations?
verbatim: Employment lawyer, Greg Martinez, on December 15, 2023, cautioned businesses to stay informed on regulations around remote work to avoid potential legal pitfalls.
